bio.text: Sean Camacho is a Democrat who represents District 6 (Denver) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on January 8, 2025, according to Ballotpedia.

According to Ballotpedia, Camacho served in the U.S. Air Force, earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Air Force Academy in 2006 and a law degree from Suffolk University Law School in 2016, and has worked as an attorney.
